const input = $input.first().json;

return [{
  json: {
    success: null,
    agent: "Agent QA", _version: '5.16',
    task_id: input.task_id,
    status: input.analysis_failed ? "ERROR" : "NEEDSIMPROVEMENT",   // analyse non exécutée = ERROR (le Go/No-Go la traite comme telle)
    global_score: input.global_score,
    approved_for_pipeline: false,
    language: input.language,
    critical_issues: input.critical_issues || [],
    warnings: input.warnings || [],
    recommendations: input.recommendations || [],
    summary: input.summary || "",
    dimensions: input.dimensions,
    timestamp: input.timestamp,
    coverage_measured: input.coverage_measured,
    unverified_issues_dropped: input.unverified_issues_dropped,
    analysis_scope: input.analysis_scope
  }
}];
